evidence.quote: We acknowledge that the case for architectural control flow may diminish as LLM capabilities in- crease.

inspection of Opus 4.6 reasoning traces revealed that the model occasionally recognizes the underlying data and produces correct answers from parametric memory without performing the required aggregation.
Our decontamination procedure relies on structured reasoning traces to detect memorization, which were not available for the harness-free model outputs.
The current OOLONG suite caps at 1M tokens, a ceiling that the raw Opus 4.6 context window already exceeds.
We note that while we have imple- mented the “map” half of map-reduce as an LLM- powered operator, we have not built corresponding llm_reduce or agentic_reduce tools.
